description: Source code for MIME type handling and icon retrieval in a file manager or similar application, including functions for determining icons based on MIME types and caching icons.

methods.name: xa_icon_name_compare_func
methods.description: Comparison function for icon cache based on icon name.

methods.name: xa_get_stock_mime_icon
methods.description: Returns icon name based on MIME type of a filename.

methods.name: xa_get_pixbuf_icon_from_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a GdkPixbuf icon from cache or loads it if not present.

methods.name: xa_free_icon_cache
methods.description: Frees all cached icons and associated resources.
